name: Steam Blender
notes: Steam multiblock: runs on steam from steam input hatches, no energy or maintenance hatch. Every tiered part (machine casing, gear box, pipe casing, firebox, frame) must be the same tier: bronze (shown) or steel (Solid Steel Machine Casing and steel parts; high-pressure steam, faster). Buses are steam input/output buses. Steam mixer (Steam Blender), 5x4x5. Hatches and buses (steam, item, input and output hatches) must face north, the same way as the controller (GT allowOnly(NORTH)); the planner only turns them that way. GT needs a steam input hatch and at least one input and one output of any kind. GT still accepts the old 7x6x7 form; this is the current shape. Sharing: every hatch found during the structure check is added to each controller whose structure contains it, so steam hatches and buses in a shared wall serve both machines.
